sentences: Many small farmers in the region depend on the monsoon for their entire income.
When the rains arrive late, they are forced to delay sowing their crops.
This delay shortens the growing season and often reduces the harvest.
As a result, farmers who borrowed money for seed struggle to repay their loans.
Insurance schemes that pay out after a poor season could ease this burden.
items.explanation: The paragraph moves from dependence on the monsoon to late rains, their effect on the harvest, the debt that follows and a possible remedy.
